note: BH-6737. Per-project Fly pool cap as a settings row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.pool_cap`, written by the console pool_cap command (bin/cmd-pool-cap.sh). A number inside flags/fly-pool-<project> still wins; fly/pool-caps.conf comes after it. 0 = no per-project ceiling. POOL_AUTOSCALE=0 ignores it, and so does ROUTING_ROWS set to anything but on (no worker read). Unset (no row) leaves the cap to the flag file and the conf.
